property.name: AspectRatio
property.summary: Gets the aspect ratio used by the graphics device.

property.name: Format
property.summary: Gets a value indicating the surface format of the display mode.
property.value: The surface format of the display mode.

property.name: Height
property.summary: Gets a value indicating the screen height, in pixels.

property.name: RefreshRate
property.summary: Gets a value indicating the refresh rate. The value of 0 indicates an adapter default.
property.value: Refresh rate. The value of 0 indicates an adapter default.

property.name: TitleSafeArea
property.summary: Returns the title safe area of the display.
property.remarks: On television sets, text should not be displayed at the outer edges of the screen because it may not be visible to the user. The title safe area is the part of the screen where text should be displayed.

property.name: Width
property.summary: Gets a value indicating the screen width, in pixels.
